author: matthewkeil
content:
The devnets that are available now with glamsterdam.  I think `devnet-8` is meant for community to start debugging app layer with.  

They are pretty unstable still though and are not feature complete yet. But they are there to try some small things.  I would generally say though they are good for "testing" not necessarily for high volume modeling or production verification.

I brought up community outreach on a couple of calls. <@199561711278227457> I can also help with this if you need a hand, just need to know how I can help.  He, or potentially I, might be a good person to speak to about where/when/how we want to facilitate this.
